caption:
A closed door? Read what Allah says about His mercy

Whatever mercy Allah opens for people, no one can hold back, and whatever He holds back, no one can release. Ask Him tonight, then rest your heart, for He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

Surah Faatir 35:2

Which door will you ask Allah to open for you tonight?

#closeddoors #allahsplan #surahfatir #quranreels

Recitation: Abdul Basit Abdus-Samad
